Fund operations run on documents, deadlines and numbers that have to be right - subscription documents to parse, capital calls to chase, portfolio data to reconcile. You build on that foundation: more agents taking that work off people's hands, the evaluations that prove they can be trusted with it, and the platform that lets every other team at bunch ship the same way. - Evaluate and improve agent performance. • Aplicar boas práticas de resiliência, observabilidade (OpenTelemetry), segurança, governança e excelência operacional nas soluções desenvolvidas.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
 
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Connect - A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.

Protect - A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve - Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

- Define and iterate on team processes, playbooks, and frameworks to build a scalable and high-performing function

- Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

The Role

Veeva is seeking a Technical Architect to join our growing Patient CRM team. This pivotal role involves designing, overseeing, and executing technical services for customer implementations of the Patient CRM product, specifically focused on the complex data ecosystem of patient support and patient engagement. You will act as a trusted advisor, blending deep technical expertise with industry knowledge to ensure seamless data connectivity between customer data sources and Patient CRM.

This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. • Lead technical discovery workshops to define integration requirements and align on architectural best practices

• Plan, manage, and perform technical build activities, including API configurations, middleware orchestration, and batch data processing

• Identify and monitor technical interdependencies between various workstreams to mitigate project risk

• Contribute to the development of technical implementation methodologies and reusable integration assets for the Patient CRM team

• Support pre-sales activities by providing technical architecture reviews, scope definition, and responding to complex functional inquiries

• Collaborate with Product and Strategy teams to provide feedback on technical capabilities and drive product excellence

• Mentor junior technical consultants to facilitate a growing and collaborative team environment

Requirements

• 7+ years of demonstrated technical consulting or technical architecture experience

• Proven expertise in Life Sciences, with a specific focus on the technical challenges of patient support and patient engagement

• Deep knowledge of modern integration approaches, including Middleware, direct REST/SOAP APIs, and secure batch file sharing

• Experience architecting data exchanges between diverse entities such as CRM platforms, hubs, and specialty pharmacies

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior IT management through technical subject matter expertise

• Adept at simplifying complex data mapping and vendor integration concepts for varying stakeholder groups

• Strong solution design skills with a focus on data integrity and security

• Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced environment
